gbm_population_evidence.quote: Recurrent or progressive GBM as evaluated by central review applying RANO criteria

candidate_evidence.quote: Patients with GBM after failure of standard first line therapy will be randomized in a 2:1 ratio to receive berubicin or lomustine for the evaluation of OS.
Berubicin HCl is a novel synthetic anthracycline with a chemical structure similar to doxorubicin HCl

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: A Study of Berubicin in Adult Subjects With Recurrent Glioblastoma Multiforme

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Plasma Pharmacokinetics Cmax: Maximum plasma concentration of Berubicin

role_evidence.quote: [EXPERIMENTAL] Berubicin: Berubicin intravenously infused will be administered at a dose of 7.1 mg/m2 as free base as a 2 hour intravenous (IV) infusion once daily for 3 consecutive days

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational synthetic anthracycline, topoisomerase II inhibitor (berubicin hydrochloride)
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: anthracycline that crosses the blood brain barrier and is not a substrate for multidrug resistance transporters

source_quote.quote: Known to have an IDH mutation prior to enrollment
Explore the effect of O[6] methylguanine-DNA methyltransferase (MGMT) methylation

coder_notes: Known IDH mutation is an exclusion criterion (coded as IDH eligibility row, IDH-wildtype-like definition of GBM, not candidate-matched). cns5 coded historical because of 'Glioblastoma Multiforme' and no positive IDH-wildtype requirement (only exclusion of known IDH mutation); an adjudicator could read the exclusion as an IDH-wildtype requirement (-> cns5). MGMT methylation status must be available at entry but no value is required; coded exploratory_correlative rather than eligibility. PK is plasma only. Lomustine is the registered active comparator.
